tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsang rngan gyi cho ga mdor bsdus dge legs kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// bsang rngan gyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa dge legs kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig bsang rngan gyi cho ga mdor bsdus bgyi bar spro na/ sa gzhi gtsang ma'i phyogs su stan dkar gtsang gi steng du 'bru dkar bcal du bkram pa'i steng*/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du/ bag phye la g.yag lug ra gsum skye mched dod par bcos pa'i mtha' skor du/ sman sna/ zas sna/ dar sna/ rin po che sna tshogs pa skye dgu'i nyer spyod du 'os pa rnams kyis bskor ba'i mdun du/ kha na ma tho ba dang bral ba'i bza' btung yid du 'ong ba rnams bshams/ mda' mdung la sogs par dar sna tshogs kyi 'phul lce btags pa/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi lo ma gzhan gyis longs spyad pa'i 'phro ma yin pa gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba spungs pa dang*/ phye mar chang phud la sogs bkod legs par 'du byas/ sgrub pa po kha shar du phyogs pa'i stan bde bar 'dug /bsang la phye mar chang phud sogs bsang rdzas bran/ rol mo gang yang rung ba dang ldan pas/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed 'gro ba sogs lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ hūm̐ */ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams sogs tshigs bdun mas gsol ba lan gsum btab pas zangs mdog dpal ri padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od gong dkar po skar mda' btang ba ltar 'phros pa rang gi snying gar thim pas rang nyid slob dpon padma 'byung gnas su ma bskyed gsal rdzogs kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas bden pa'i mchog /chags bral bden gnyis dam chos bden pa'i mchog |tshogs kyi zhing gyur dge 'dun bden pa'i mchog

/bslu med nges pa rgyu 'bras bden pa'i mchog /las kun 'grub byed lhag bsam bden pa'i mchog /dkon mchog bka' la mi nyan gang yang med// rgyu 'bras bden pas bslu ba gang yang med// lhag bsam bden pas mi 'grub gang yang med// skya ring lam la mi 'gro gang yang med// 'bab pa'i chu ni mi 'thung gang yang med// dgung sngon 'og tu mi gnas gang yang med// nyi zla'i 'od kyis mi gsal gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la mi gces gang yang med// bden pa'i ngag gis de ring mgron rigs bzhir// bsang rngan mchod pa 'bul gyi 'dir gshegs shig /chu 'dzin bsil bus brlams 'dra'i 'brong chen 'gying*// gangs dkar tshal pa ltar mdzes g.yang mo lug /tsandan ljon pa ji bzhin gnam ru ra// 'dod yon rin chen sman 'bru dar zab tshogs// 'o ma 'dzag pa'i gnyis skyes 'dab mas bsangs// phye mar rtsi bcud bran pa'i dud sprin spos// stong khams khyab pa'i mchod sprin rmad byung ba// dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'dis// kun tu bzang po khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// zas gtsang sras po grub mchog padma 'byung*// rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin sum ldan sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams la// bsang dang rngan gyi mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul// sangs rgyas chos tshogs dkon mchog rnam gsum dang*// byang sems nyan rang lha mi'i drang srong tshogs| |bsang rngan mchod pa'i sprin gyis dgyes gyur cig /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs// gsang chen snga 'gyur theg pa'i rgyal po che// dkyil 'khor lha la bsang rngan mchod pa 'bul// dus kyi 'khor lo bde dgyes gsang ba 'dus// sgyu thod gdan bzhi gshed skor bla med rgyud// rnal 'byor rgyud dang spyod pa bya rgyud sogs| |phyi 'gyur dkyil 'khor lha la bsang mchod 'bul// dpal ldan ma hā kā lā khrag 'thung che// lha mo rab 'jigs srid gsum srog gi bdag

/rang rang 'khor bcas dam can rgya mtsho rnams// bsang rngan mchod pas thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro la sogs pa// yul chen nyer bzhi so bdun gnas la sogs// zhing rnams skyong mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// bsang rngan mchod pas rtag tu dgyes gyur cig /dgra lha pho lha yul lha srog zhang lha// ban bon le gu srung ma bang lhar bcas// 'go ba'i lha rnams bsang rngan phud kyis mchod// pho mo klu rgyud kyis bsdus sde brgyad sogs// gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag la sogs pa// mchod 'os kun la bsang rngan mchod pa 'bul| |bgegs dang log 'dren bdag la 'tshe ba rnams// bsang dang rngan gyis mchod do gdug rtsub spongs// khams gsum rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron// bsang rngan mchod pas tshims shing rang gyur cig /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// 'go ba'i lha lnga srung skyob mgon byed rnams// dbu 'phang srid rtse las mthor bstod par bgyi| |mgon byed lha kun bdag la lus grib ltar// mi 'bral 'grogs nas rtag tu bsrung gyur cig /mgron bzhi bsang rngan mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bdag cag 'khor bcas gzhi byes gang du yang*// rtag tu srung zhing skyong ba rgya chen mdzod// snod bcud kun gyi phywa g.yang bdag la bsdus// legs pa brgya stong dag dang 'phrad pa dang*// nyes pa kun dang bral zhing med par mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang rlung bcas// dbyar gyi mtsho dang yar ngo'i zla tshes ltar// rim bzhin 'phel zhing rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// snyan pa'i grags pa dbyar rnga lta bu sgrogs// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa// sbyin pa rgya chen 'di nyid la brten nas// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sgrib gnyis kun bcom nas// don gnyis 'grub pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzod// ces brjod/

bkra shis dang bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ phye mar la longs spyod/ ces pa'ang zhal ngo gang nang tshang nas bskul ngor/ gangs can ljongs kyi 'dren pa gcig pu rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos grub dbang padma'i rgyal tshab tu bsngags shing dbang bskur ba/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa gsang ba sngags kyi mthu grub pa thugs kyi rdo rje zhes sam/ ming gzhan chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka'i yang thog tu mgyogs bris bgyis pa'o// shu bhaṃ/// /
